note: Local Codex is an offline evaluation route. It reuses the operator's existing Codex login and stores no credential in this repository.

routes.note: Runs one ephemeral, read-only Codex session per sample from an isolated temporary working directory.

judges.note: Pinned to an OpenAI-family model present in the local model catalog and compatible with the installed standalone CLI. gpt-5.6-sol was rejected by the service because codex-cli 0.120.0 is too old. The generator family is DeepSeek, so the self-preference exclusion remains satisfied.

independence_caveat: The OpenAI-family Codex judge reduces the shared Chinese-native-family blind spot, but all three judges remain LLMs and do not replace the required hidden human review.
